items.title: WYOMING ATHLETICS ANNOUNCES "LIGHT UP LARADISE" FOR NOVEMBER 20 FOOTBALL SHOWDOWN AGAINST NEW MEXICO
items.summary: LARAMIE, Wyo. (Nov. 11, 2026) – Wyoming Athletics is calling on Cowboy Country to help create one of the most electric atmospheres in War Memorial Stadium history with the launch of "Light Up Laradise," a first-of-its-kind fan experience set for Friday, Nov. 20, when the Wyoming Cowboys host nationally ranked New Mexico at 7 p.m.

items.title: Cowboys Head to UTEP To Renew an Old Rivalry with Miners
items.summary: LARAMIE, Wyo. (Nov. 9, 2026) – The Wyoming Cowboys will wrap up the road portion of the schedule with a trip to an old rival in UTEP on Saturday evening. The contest is slated for an 8 p.m. MT start on FS1 at the Sun Bowl in El Paso, Texas. It marks the first meeting between the schools since the 1995 season.

items.title: Trio of Cowboys Earn Old Trapper Mountain West Player of the Week Honors
items.summary: LARAMIE, Wyo. (Nov. 9, 2026) – Wyoming had a trio of players earn Old Trapper Player of the Week honors by the Mountain West on Monday.  It is the first time in Wyoming's time as a member of the MW that UW has had three players garner Player of the Week honors.

items.title: Cowboys Set for Mountain West Clash in Vegas with UNLV
items.summary: LARAMIE, Wyo. (Nov. 2, 2026) – The Wyoming Cowboys hit the road for a key Mountain West Conference contest in Vegas against UNLV on Saturday evening at Allegiant Stadium. The contest is set for an 8:30 p.m. MT for the latest kick this season for the Brown and Gold.
